method: R50 historical transfer activity observed as dated effective transfer records, not dated announcements or proof of historical actual knowledge. Map 25 matching Crown leagues and a conservative one-to-one team ID bridge from R49, use only transfers effective at least 3 UTC days before target. Markets entirely Crown T24/T12 quote event; no outcome-driven leg selection and all previously approved eight groups frozen. Compare baseline price path vs club inbound/outbound count momentum vs value/missingness additional fields via strictly prior-calendar-year model fit, excluding actual receipt target IDs. 90/365 day window are experimental historical features and not a production gate. Market values are retrospective transfer-time estimates with missingness, not live or independently verifiable contemporaneous team roster valuations; the future-dated transfers in source are excluded. Original 8 and old unpromoted OU candidates are subtracted only for hindsight incremental cohort reporting. Source stopped 2026-07-06, October-November actual receipt cohort invalid for this dataset; no ROI claimed.
